findings.title: Substring matching enables upsampling for queries that exclude errors
findings.body: This checks whether the raw query contains `event.type:error`, not whether the query selects only errors. For example, the valid discover query `!event.type:error` contains this substring but excludes errors; an `event.type:error OR event.type:transaction` query also matches while including transactions. For allowlisted projects these queries are rewritten to sum `sample_weight`, so they can return incorrect counts or fail when that column is unavailable for transaction events.

findings.title: Upsampling eligibility ignores the effective dataset and query
findings.body: `_get_event_stats` receives the effective `scoped_dataset` and `query`, but eligibility is decided using the outer `dataset` and the original request. Dashboard split paths can call this function with a discover error split and a generated query while the original dataset is a metrics dataset and the request has no `event.type:error` filter. In that case the split's error counts are not upsampled, so the feature returns sampled rather than estimated counts.

findings.title: Remove the unregistered nested-repository gitlink
findings.body: This adds a gitlink to commit `a5d2909` rather than a normal source file. No `.gitmodules` entry is included, so a fresh checkout will not populate this directory and submodule initialization cannot resolve its URL. Remove this accidental repository entry unless it is an intentional, fully configured submodule.
